title: CodeServo gate observation
description: The structured document a gate declaring result_format = "codeservo-json" writes where the controller told it to: a shell gate is given the location in $CODESERVO_OBSERVATION_PATH, a provider task as its one argument. The exit code remains the verdict; this document says what was measured. A gate declaring a format the controller projects, result_format = "junit-xml" or "sarif", writes nothing here: the controller reads the reports its tool wrote and projects them onto this same shape.
